ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows a 2×2×2 large cube composed of 8 small dice. From the viewing angle, only the exposed faces of 7 of the dice can be seen, and the only die not shown is the die at the back-left-bottom corner. According to the visible markings in the figure, the three adjacent dice sharing faces with this hidden die are respectively: the die directly above it, whose top face is marked R; the bottom-layer die directly in front of it, marked P; and the bottom-layer die directly to its right, marked S. Reasoning: The problem states that any two dice whose faces are in contact must have different letters written on them. Therefore, the letter on the hidden die cannot be the same as the letters on these three adjacent dice, that is, it cannot be R, P, or S. The only available letters are P, Q, R, S. After excluding P, R, and S, only Q remains. So the letter on the hidden die is Q.

From the image, identify the three dice sharing a face with that hidden die: the die directly above it has top label R, the die directly in front of it in the bottom layer has label P, and the die directly to its right in the bottom layer has label S. From the text, use the rule that any two dice with touching faces must have different letters. Therefore the hidden die cannot be R, P, or S; among P, Q, R, S, the only remaining possible letter is Q.
